questions.question: When David fled Jerusalem because of his son Absalom, what did David warn would happen if he and his servants did not leave quickly?

answers.text: Absalom would catch up and strike the city
The gates would be shut and David's household would be trapped
The people would turn on David in the streets

questions.question: When King David told Ittai the Gittite to go back, what did Ittai answer?

answers.text: He would be wherever the king was
He would go back and serve the new king
He would head home and wait for news

questions.question: David sent the ark of God back to Jerusalem. What did David say would happen if he found favor with the LORD?

answers.text: The LORD would bring him back to see it again
The LORD would send the ark out to him
The LORD would give him a new city

questions.question: Why did David send his friend Hushai back to Jerusalem to act as Absalom's servant?

answers.text: To talk Absalom into giving up
